ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_delta_rank_exp_mix
ir.intuition: Shift paradigm from pairwise_diff/margin to a probabilistic ranking paradigm using delta_rank signal as soft ordering confidence. Apply an exponential decay transform on delta_rank to emphasize pairs with small rank difference and use a sigmoid link on the log probability difference. Aggregate by weighted geometric mean to emphasize multiplicative relations. Enforce positivity constraint via exp transform.
ir.pseudocode:
delta = batch['delta_rank']
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
diff = lpw - lpl
score = sigmoid(diff)
weight_exp = exp(-abs(delta))
loss_per_pair = -log(score) * weight_exp * weight
loss = exp(mean(log(loss_per_pair + eps)))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # log_prob difference
    score = ops.sigmoid(diff)  # probability winner preferred

    weight_exp = ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.abs(delta_rank)))  # emphasize small rank gaps

    eps = 1e-9
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.log(ops.add(score, eps))), weight_exp)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    log_loss = ops.log(ops.add(loss_per_pair, eps))
    mean_log_loss = ops.mean(log_loss)

    loss = ops.exp(mean_log_loss)  # geometric mean aggregation enforcing positive loss

    return loss
